## Artifact Summary

**File written:** `workspace/src/memory_access.sv`  
**Module:** `memory_access` — exact port list from spec preserved.

### Implemented behaviour

| Path | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Store (MemRW=01) / SB** | ByteEnable one-hot on the addressed lane; byte placed at the correct offset in WriteData |
| **Store / SH** | ByteEnable `0011` or `1100` per AddrLSB[1]; low halfword placed at the addressed lane |
| **Store / SW** | ByteEnable `1111`; WriteData = StoreData |
| **Load (MemRW=10) / LB** | 8-bit byte selected by AddrLSB, sign-extended to 32 bits |
| **Load / LH** | 16-bit halfword selected by AddrLSB[1], sign-extended to 32 bits |
| **Load / LW** | ReadData passed through unchanged |
| **Load / LBU** | Byte selected by AddrLSB, zero-extended to 32 bits |
| **Load / LHU** | Halfword selected by AddrLSB[1], zero-extended to 32 bits |
| **Defaults** | ByteEnable=0, WriteData=0 when MemRW≠01; LoadData=0 when MemRW≠10 |

**Style:** single `always_comb`, all outputs defaulted before any conditional, no clocks, no latches, no package imports — synthesizable and Icarus Verilog 12 compatible.
